summary: Global Mofy AI Limited (a Cayman Islands company) filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, disclosing a self-underwritten registered direct offering of 3,796,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.538 per share, with gross proceeds of approximately $2.04 million. Shares were sold directly to investors under an existing Form F-3 registration statement (No. 333-294113) and prospectus supplement dated August 31, 2026. Proceeds are earmarked for working capital. No discounts, fees, or commissions were paid. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
